spans.s: बोध m. 1. Perception, apprehension, observation; 2. wisdom, intellect, intelligence; 3. waking, becoming awake; 4. expanding, opening, blossoming; 5. advice, instruction, admonition; 6. an epithet, a designation.
बोध-कर m. 1. a bard whose duty it is to wake a prince by singing songs in the morning; 2. a teacher.
बोध-वासर n. the eleventh day in the first half of the month of Kārtīka when Viṣṇu is supposed to awake from his sleep. See Megh.ii.47.
बोधक (I) a. (f. धिका) 1. Instructing, teaching; 2. awaking, rousing.
बोधक (I) a. (f. धिका) 1. Instructing, teaching; 2. awaking, rousing.
बोधन (II) n. 1. Instruction, teaching, भयरुषोश्च तदिंगितबोधनम् R.ix.49; 2. awaking, awakening, rousing, समयेन तेन चिरसुप्तमनोभवबोधनं सममबोधिषत Sis.ix.24; 3. signifying, denoting; 4. burning incense.
बोधान m. 1. An epithet of Bṛhaspati; 2. a learned man.
बोधनी f. 1. The eleventh day of the first half of Kārtīka when Viṣṇu awakes from his sleep; 2. long pepper.
बोधि m. 1. Perfect knowledge; 2. the sacred fig tree; 3. a cock; 4. an epithet of Buddha.
बोधि-तरु, -द्रुम, -वृक्ष m. the sacred fig tree.
बोधि-तरु, -द्रुम, -वृक्ष m. the sacred fig tree.
बोधि-तरु, -द्रुम, -वृक्ष m. the sacred fig tree.
बोधि-सत्व m. one who has attained perfect wisdom and has only a limited number of births to undergo before reaching the state of total annihilation, M.M.x.
बोधित a. (f. ता) 1. Informed, made known; 2. instructed, advised.
बोधित a. (f. ता) 1. Informed, made known; 2. instructed, advised.
